Maya: 🎉 All-hands is live — throw your snacks, one-line takeaways, and dumb applause here! :loud_sound:
Raj: e-popcorn delivered. also for the record: team song request = 'desk plant anthem' :seedling: :guitar:
Ellen: lol plant anthem forever. my takeaway: fewer meetings, more naps. :zzz: :joy:
Sam: Quick poll: what's the official snack of the quarter? 1) Pretzels 2) Chocolate 3) Fruit 4) Cookies. React with :one: :two: :three: :four:
Leah: :two: but only if it's dark chocolate :drooling_face:
Ben: :four: for immediate morale boost. Also: shoutout to infra team, that rollout looked smooth :clap:
Kai: +1 to Ben — huge thanks infra. also @Maya you killed it on the roadmap demo :sparkles:
Maya: thanks! huge team effort. sending virtual high-fives to everyone :handshake: :handshake:
ops-bot: Recording started for all-hands (transcript will be available in #docs in ~15m).
Raj: gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheer-popcorn-3o6ZsYt1gWqQn1b8Zq
Ellen: who else is saving the slide about 'quantum burritos' for the sequel? :taco: :rocket:
Sam: tiny follow-up: office plant watering rota sign-up in #random — volunteers? I'm terrible at remembering water :grimacing:
Leah: i'll take week 2. promise to remember. maybe set a calendar reminder :calendar:
Ben: :thumbsup: signed up, also sending confetti for the product demo :confetti_ball:
Kai: endnote: if anyone wants a physical snack drop, DM me — got a limited cookie stash in the office fridge :wink:
Maya: ok that was delightful. back to code but keep the gifs coming :cat2:
